description: AddressesService module managing user addresses with localStorage fallback and optional backend integration, including address CRUD operations and default address handling.

methods.name: listAddresses
methods.description: Returns list of addresses from localStorage, with backend fallback and pre-seeding with friendly labels if empty.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves an address by id from localStorage.

methods.name: createAddress
methods.description: Creates a new address, assigns a UUID, and persists it to localStorage, updating default address if specified.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address by id with provided changes.

methods.name: removeAddress
methods.description: Removes an address by id and updates the selected address if necessary.

methods.name: setDefaultAddress
methods.description: Sets a specific address as default and updates localStorage and selected address.

methods.name: getDefaultAddress
methods.description: Returns the currently selected address or default address.

methods.name: selectAddress
methods.description: Sets the selected address by id without changing its default status.

methods.name: getSelectedAddressId
methods.description: Returns the id of the currently selected address.
